description: Filesystem read/write operations. Supports write_text, read_text, list_dir, delete, and exists actions. Path-traversal protected. Mirrors engine/capabilities/filesystem.py.
instructions: Actions: write_text, read_text, list_dir, delete, exists.
All paths are resolved relative to the capability workdir. Path traversal (../) is rejected by guardrails.
Always validate the action parameter before operating on the filesystem.
Return output with the action result and normalized path.
